```{python}
#| label: setup
#| code-summary: "Setup — paths, DuckDB connection, helpers"

import sys
from pathlib import Path

_this = Path.cwd()
_project_root = _this if (_this / "src").exists() else _this.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(_project_root))

import pandas as pd
import duckdb
from itables import init_notebook_mode
init_notebook_mode(all_interactive=False)

from src.parsers.quarto_helpers import (
    fmt_pct, fmt_int, safe_int, show_df, show_md, plotly_bar,
    has_col, has_view, table_count, setup_notebook,
)

SOURCE_KEY     = "antigravity_cli"
SOURCE_TITLE   = "Antigravity CLI"
SOURCE_COLOR   = "#7C3AED"
MUTED          = "#D1D5DB"
PROCESSED      = _project_root / "data" / "processed" / "Antigravity CLI"
TABLES         = ["conversations", "messages", "tool_events", "branches"]
AUX_TABLES     = []
ACCOUNT_FILTER = None

con = duckdb.connect()
_setup = setup_notebook(con, SOURCE_KEY, PROCESSED, TABLES, AUX_TABLES, ACCOUNT_FILTER)
```

> **About Antigravity CLI:** parquets are captured from
> `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/`. Readable JSONL trajectories provide messages,
> thinking and tool activity. SQLite and legacy `.pb` containers are preserved
> raw; opaque legacy containers appear as zero-message conversations.
